title: LCK regulates apoptosis and intercellular communication networks in neuroblastoma.
snippet: Neuroblastoma is the most common solid malignancy of childhood with poor prognosis in high-risk patients. The tumor microenvironment, particularly the metastatic bone marrow niche, plays a critical role in disease progression.
